+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""O1: CPU vs METAL in one process, per-tensor device=. Forward + gradient.
+Comparison mirrors diff_test.py (nan-pattern, allclose equal_nan=True).
+Usage: uv run python scratch/hunt/o1_runner.py [T1 T2 ...] [--csv path]"""
+import sys, os, csv, time, signal, traceback
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
+import numpy as np
+from cases import CASES, inputs_for, weight_for
+
+from tinygrad import Tensor
+
+RTOL_F, ATOL_F = 1e-3, 1e-5     # forward, mirrors diff_test.py defaults
+RTOL_G, ATOL_G = 1e-2, 1e-4     # looser for grads per protocol
+DEVICES = os.environ.get("O1_DEVICES", "CPU,METAL").split(",")
+TIMEOUT = int(os.environ.get("CASE_TIMEOUT", "60"))
+
+class CaseTimeout(Exception): pass
+def _alarm(sig, frm): raise CaseTimeout()
+signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, _alarm)
+
+def maxdiff(a, b):
+  if a.shape != b.shape: return float("inf")
+  if a.size == 0: return 0.0
+  d = np.abs(a.astype(np.float64) - b.astype(np.float64))
+  return float(np.nanmax(d)) if not np.all(np.isnan(d)) else 0.0
+
+def run_one(case, dev):
+  ins = inputs_for(case)
+  ts = [Tensor(a, device=dev) for a in ins]
+  out = case.fn(*ts)
+  fwd = out.numpy()
+  gs = None
+  if case.grad:
+    w = Tensor(weight_for(case, fwd.shape), device=dev)
+    gs = [g.numpy() for g in (out * w).sum().gradient(*ts)]
+  return fwd, gs
+
+def compare(case, ref, res):
+  rf, rg = ref; f, g = res
+  status, worst_f, worst_g = "PASS", maxdiff(f, rf), 0.0
+  if f.shape != rf.shape: return "SHAPE_MISMATCH", worst_f, worst_g
+  if np.isnan(f).sum() != np.isnan(rf).sum(): status = "NAN_PATTERN_FWD"
+  elif not np.allclose(f, rf, rtol=RTOL_F, atol=ATOL_F, equal_nan=True): status = "FWD_MISMATCH"
+  if g is not None and rg is not None:
+    for gi, rgi in zip(g, rg):
+      worst_g = max(worst_g, maxdiff(gi, rgi))
+      if status == "PASS" and np.isnan(gi).sum() != np.isnan(rgi).sum(): status = "NAN_PATTERN_GRAD"
+      elif status == "PASS" and not np.allclose(gi, rgi, rtol=RTOL_G, atol=ATOL_G, equal_nan=True): status = "GRAD_MISMATCH"
+  return status, worst_f, worst_g
+
+def main():
+  args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if not a.startswith("--")]
+  targets = set(args) if args else None
+  csv_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "sweep_log.csv")
+  newfile = not os.path.exists(csv_path)
+  fcsv = open(csv_path, "a", newline="", buffering=1)
+  w = csv.writer(fcsv)
+  if newfile: w.writerow(["ts","oracle","target","case","status","maxdiff_fwd","maxdiff_grad","secs","note"])
+  sel = [c for c in CASES if targets is None or c.target in targets]
+  npass = nfail = 0
+  for case in sel:
+    t0 = time.time(); status, note, wf, wg = "?", "", 0.0, 0.0
+    w.writerow([int(t0), "O1", case.target, case.id, "BEGIN", "", "", "", ""])
+    try:
+      signal.alarm(TIMEOUT)
+      results = {}
+      for dev in DEVICES:
+        try:
+          results[dev] = run_one(case, dev)
+        except CaseTimeout: raise
+        except Exception as e:
+          results[dev] = ("ERR", f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:200]}")
+      signal.alarm(0)
+      errs = {d: r[1] for d, r in results.items() if r[0] == "ERR"}
+      if len(errs) == len(DEVICES):
+        # both error: agreement of a sort, but log which
+        status, note = "BOTH_ERROR", "; ".join(f"{d}:{m}" for d, m in errs.items())
+      elif errs:
+        status, note = "ONE_SIDE_ERROR", "; ".join(f"{d}:{m}" for d, m in errs.items())
+      else:
+        ref = results[DEVICES[0]]
+        for dev in DEVICES[1:]:
+          status, wf, wg = compare(case, ref, results[dev])
+    except CaseTimeout:
+      signal.alarm(0); status, note = "TIMEOUT", f">{TIMEOUT}s"
+    except Exception as e:
+      signal.alarm(0); status, note = "HARNESS_ERROR", f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:200]}"; traceback.print_exc()
+    secs = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
+    w.writerow([int(t0), "O1", case.target, case.id, status, f"{wf:.3e}", f"{wg:.3e}", secs, note])

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Run cases on ONE device under whatever env flags the parent set; save npz per case.
+Used for env-flag oracles (O3 NOOPT, O4 VALIDATE_WITH_CPU, O5 PCONTIG).
+Usage: DEV=CPU NOOPT=1 uv run python scratch/hunt/case_exec.py --out scratch/hunt/out/cpu_noopt [T1 ...]"""
+import sys, os, signal, traceback
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
+import numpy as np
+from cases import CASES, inputs_for, weight_for
+
+TIMEOUT = int(os.environ.get("CASE_TIMEOUT", "60"))
+class CaseTimeout(Exception): pass
+signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, lambda s, f: (_ for _ in ()).throw(CaseTimeout()))
+
+def main():
+  out_dir = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--out") + 1]
+  targets = set(a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a.startswith("T"))
+  os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
+  from tinygrad import Tensor  # import after env is set by parent
+  sel = [c for c in CASES if not targets or c.target in targets]
+  for case in sel:
+    path = os.path.join(out_dir, case.id + ".npz")
+    if os.path.exists(path) or os.path.exists(path + ".err"): continue
+    open(path + ".begin", "w").close()
+    try:
+      signal.alarm(TIMEOUT)
+      ins = inputs_for(case)
+      ts = [Tensor(a) for a in ins]   # default device from DEV env
+      out = case.fn(*ts)
+      fwd = out.numpy()
+      data = {"fwd": fwd}
+      if case.grad:
+        w = Tensor(weight_for(case, fwd.shape))
+        for i, g in enumerate((out * w).sum().gradient(*ts)): data[f"g{i}"] = g.numpy()
+      signal.alarm(0)
+      np.savez(path, **data)
+    except Exception as e:
+      signal.alarm(0)
+      with open(path + ".err", "w") as f: f.write(f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}\n{traceback.format_exc()[:2000]}")
+    finally:
+      os.unlink(path + ".begin")
+    print(case.id, "done", flush=True)
+
+if __name__ == "__main__": main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compare two case_exec output dirs, append to sweep_log.csv.
+Usage: uv run python scratch/hunt/compare_npz.py <oracle_name> <ref_dir> <test_dir>"""
+import sys, os, csv, time, glob
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
+from cases import CASES
+
+RTOL_F, ATOL_F = 1e-3, 1e-5
+RTOL_G, ATOL_G = 1e-2, 1e-4
+
+def maxdiff(a, b):
+  if a.shape != b.shape: return float("inf")
+  if a.size == 0: return 0.0
+  d = np.abs(a.astype(np.float64) - b.astype(np.float64))
+  return float(np.nanmax(d)) if not np.all(np.isnan(d)) else 0.0
+
+oracle, ref_dir, test_dir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
+case_by_id = {c.id: c for c in CASES}
+csv_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "sweep_log.csv")
+w = csv.writer(open(csv_path, "a", newline="", buffering=1))
+npass = ncase = 0
+for ref_path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(ref_dir, "*.npz"))):
+  cid = os.path.basename(ref_path)[:-4]
+  target = case_by_id[cid].target if cid in case_by_id else "?"
+  test_path = os.path.join(test_dir, cid + ".npz")
+  status, wf, wg, note = "PASS", 0.0, 0.0, ""
+  if not os.path.exists(test_path):
+    err = test_path + ".err"
+    if os.path.exists(err):
+      reftxt = open(err).read().splitlines()[0][:160]
+      # if ref also errored there'd be no ref npz; so this is one-sided
+      status, note = "ONE_SIDE_ERROR", reftxt
+    else:
+      status, note = "MISSING", "no output (timeout/crash?)"
+  else:
+    ref, test = np.load(ref_path), np.load(test_path)
+    for k in ref.files:
+      if k not in test.files: status, note = "MISSING_KEY", k; break
+      a, b = ref[k], test[k]
+      d = maxdiff(a, b)
+      if k == "fwd": wf = max(wf, d)
+      else: wg = max(wg, d)
+      rt, at = (RTOL_F, ATOL_F) if k == "fwd" else (RTOL_G, ATOL_G)
+      if a.shape != b.shape: status, note = "SHAPE_MISMATCH", k; break
+      if np.isnan(a).sum() != np.isnan(b).sum(): status, note = "NAN_PATTERN", k; break
+      if not np.allclose(a, b, rtol=rt, atol=at, equal_nan=True):
+        status = "FWD_MISMATCH" if k == "fwd" else "GRAD_MISMATCH"; note = k; break
+  w.writerow([int(time.time()), oracle, target, cid, status, f"{wf:.3e}", f"{wg:.3e}", "", note])
+  npass += status == "PASS"; ncase += 1
+  if status != "PASS": print(f"{cid:32s} {status:16s} fwd={wf:.2e} grad={wg:.2e} {note[:70]}")
+# also surface ref-side errors (both errored = both_error; test-only handled above)
+for err_path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(ref_dir, "*.err"))):
+  cid = os.path.basename(err_path)[:-8]
+  target = case_by_id[cid].target if cid in case_by_id else "?"
+  test_err = os.path.join(test_dir, cid + ".npz.err")
+  both = os.path.exists(test_err)
+  status = "BOTH_ERROR" if both else "REF_SIDE_ERROR"
+  note = open(err_path).read().splitlines()[0][:160]
+  w.writerow([int(time.time()), oracle, target, cid, status, "", "", "", note])
+  ncase += 1
+  print(f"{cid:32s} {status:16s} {note[:70]}")
+print(f"{oracle}: {npass} pass / {ncase} compared")

+"""T7: reduce-then-broadcast-back elementwise fusions. Appends to CASES on import.
+Imported for its side effect by o1_runner.py alongside cases.py."""
+from cases import CASES, Case
+
+def _norm_sub(a):
+  return a - a.mean(axis=-1, keepdim=True)
+
+def _norm_div(a):
+  return a / (a.sum(axis=-1, keepdim=True) + 1.0)
+
+def _max_shift_exp(a):
+  return (a - a.max(axis=-1, keepdim=True)).exp()
+
+def _bcast_mul_reduce(a):
+  m = a.mean(axis=0, keepdim=True)
+  return (a * m).sum(axis=1)
+
+_T7 = [
+  Case("t7_meansub_1d", _norm_sub, True, "T7"),
+  Case("t7_meansub_2d", _norm_sub, True, "T7"),
+  Case("t7_sumdiv_2d", _norm_div, True, "T7"),
+  Case("t7_sumdiv_3d", _norm_div, True, "T7"),
+  Case("t7_maxshift_exp_2d", _max_shift_exp, True, "T7"),
+  Case("t7_bcast_mul_reduce", _bcast_mul_reduce, True, "T7"),
+]
+CASES += _T7
+import cases_t7  # noqa: F401  -- appends T7 family to CASES
